subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reconhecer e grafar, corretamente, palavras derivadas com os sufixos -agem, -oso, -eza, -izar/-isar (regulares morfológicas).

components.description_pt: Reconhecer palavras derivadas formadas com sufixos -agem, -oso, -eza e -izar/-isar
components.description_en: Recognize derived words formed with the suffixes -agem, -oso, -eza, and -izar/-isar
components.cc_component_description: Identify how suffixes change the part of speech of a base word

components.description_pt: Aplicar ortografia correta em palavras derivadas formadas com sufixo -agem ou -oso
components.description_en: Apply correct spelling to derived words formed with the suffix -agem or -oso
components.cc_component_description: Spell words formed by adding common suffixes such as -ing, -ed, -es, and -ness to base words

cc_matches.description: Identify and correctly use patterns of word changes that indicate different meanings or parts of speech (e.g., analyze, analysis, analytical; advocate, advocacy).
Use conventional spelling for high-frequency and other studied words and for adding suffixes to base words (e.g., sitting, smiled, cries, happiness).
